item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Wutip will move across Hainan Island tomorrow. It will then move towards the vicinity of Beibu Wan to Leizhou Peninsula. There will be heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windy with swells. With Wutip moving inland and under the influence of an active southerly airstream and upper-air disturbances over the coast of Guangdong, there will still be occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms early to midweek next week. The upper-air disturbances are expected to depart gradually in the latter part of next week. Showers will ease off and it will be hot over the coast of Guangdong.

Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times later. There will be swells.
